metadata.question: In Janaury 2020, did the city of Mahajanga experience more than 12 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mahajanga, Madagascar (approximately -15.7167, 46.3167) - Date: January 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31) - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is reliable for rainfall - Alternative: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) if CHIRPS fails 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed for precipitation data - CHIRPS provides daily precipitation in mm - Need to sum total precipitation for January 2020 3. Logic: - 12 inches = 304.8 mm - Sum all daily precipitation values for January 2020 - Valid Zero: If total is 0-304.8mm → B (No) - If total > 304.8mm → A (Yes) - C1: If no images found - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS over land) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mahajanga = ee.Geometry.Point([46.3167, -15.7167]); const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily Precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(mahajanga); const imageCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data available for Mahajanga in January 2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate total precipitation const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Extract value for Mahajanga point const precipStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mahajanga, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalMm = precipStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Answer if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } const totalInches = totalMm / 25.4; const threshold = 12.0; console.log(`Total rainfall in January 2020: ${totalMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${totalInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} inches (${(threshold * 25.4).toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log(`Number of days with data: ${imageCount}`); if (totalInches > threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
